principle: Generate one evidence-backed alert once, then route it to any approved channel without changing the watchdog logic.

channels.label: RSS / Atom
channels.notes: Works with feed readers and many automation tools.

channels.label: Generic webhook
channels.notes: Hosted outbound retry/DLQ worker still required for SLA-grade push.

channels.label: Email
channels.notes: Needs a hosted mail provider/account before autonomous delivery can be claimed.

channels.label: Telegram
channels.notes: Requires bot token plus target chat/channel once; Telegram Bot API supports HTTP message delivery.

channels.label: Slack
channels.notes: Best production path is a Slack App/OAuth install; workspace approval may be required.

channels.label: X
channels.notes: Requires approved X developer use, API credentials, bot disclosure and automation-policy compliance. No spam/bulk outreach.
